屋根を浮かせて建て直す：When an arena becomes a business platform

Oak View Group helped redevelop Seattle's Climate Pledge Arena while preserving its historic roof. OVGは単なる施設管理会社ではなく、開発・運営・興行誘致・スポンサー営業をつなぐ事業者だ。This article explores its 2015 origin, venue economics, public-private contracts, a troubled UK opening and a 2025 U.S. antitrust case. The central question is not merely venue profitability, but who receives the benefits and who bears the risks.
